title: coolSearch v0.4.0 Update
release_notes:
• O(N) NTFS Indexing Speedup: Instant drive indexing with parent directory memoization.
• Exact Match Search Filter: Instant toggle to match exact filenames ignoring extensions.
• Dynamic Extension Selector: Real-time extension breakdown dropdown with item counts.
• Adaptive Keystroke Debouncing: Smooth keystroke processing for million-file search indices.
• React Rendering Optimization: 60FPS UI transitions with memoized file results.
• Instant In-App Updates: Instant OTA update detection, progress tracking, and one-click installation.
